site_name: Land adjacent to Northwick Park Hospital, Nightingale Avenue, London, HA1 3GX
description: Non material amendment to amend wording of Condition 28 (Meanwhile use Strategy) and Condition 37 (Noise Levels) of Full Planning Permission application reference 20/0701 dated 16/03/2023 for Full planning permission for demolition of existing buildings and structures on the site, all site preparation works for a residential led mixed-use development comprising new homes, associated car and cycle spaces, a replacement nursery, commercial space, associated highways improvements, open space, hard and soft landscaping and public realm works subject to a deed of agreement under Section 106 of the Town and Country Planning Act dated the 16th of March 2023.
